risks.risk: Engine may not run or may have internal issues (knock, compression loss).
risks.proof: Video of the engine running with audible sound, plus a compression test reading if possible.
Photo of odometer or original vehicle service record tied to this unit.
Video showing gearbox shifting through gears on a test rig or bench.

risks.risk: Multiple similar units are stacked together; the exact item for sale is not isolated or tagged.
risks.proof: A photo isolating the specific unit for sale with a tag, sticker, or marking matching the listing.
risks.if_unproven: priced with uncertainty discount for unit-mismatch risk

risks.risk: Claimed Belgium import origin ('Tokunbo') cannot be confirmed, which affects trust in overall provenance and condition grading.
risks.proof: Import/customs clearance document or shipping manifest referencing this part.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified origin, no premium for claimed provenance

proof_requests: Video of the engine running with clear audio to check for knocking.
Close-up photo of the engine code stamp (to confirm 2ZR).
Photo of odometer or any mileage/service documentation.
Video of gearbox being shifted through gears.
Photo isolating the specific unit for sale, separate from the other stacked engines, with any identifying tag.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as a used engine/gearbox assembly, but every seller claim about code, condition, mileage, and origin is unverifiable from the single photo, so it must be priced at worst case pending proof.
